caption: The drawing is a monochromatic pencil sketch on off-white paper, featuring a single large object centered within a rectangular border. The object is a metal pitcher with a wide, slightly flared rim, a rounded body that narrows in the middle, and a bulbous lower section that rests on a circular base. The pitcher has a single curved handle attached at the rim and the upper body, extending outward and then looping downward. The shading on the pitcher gives it a metallic appearance. In the lower left corner, within a smaller square, there is a simple side-profile outline of the pitcher along with measurement markings to its left and bottom. The artist's signature "V. Carano" appears in the bottom right corner within the main border. The overall composition is balanced, with the pitcher as the primary subject occupying the center of the page, and the smaller technical drawing providing additional detail in the corner.
title: Silver Mug
